question: Nalanda University was established by ______ in the 5th century.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kumaragupta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Kumargupta founded Nalanda University in the 5th century A.D**.

 
 
• He was also called Shakraditya.
 
 
 
• Nalanda University:
 
 
• Constructed during the rule of Kumar Gupta of the Gupta dynasty.
 
• **Mahayana monks Asnaga and Vasubandhu said to have found Nalanda in 400-500AD.**
 
• Chinese pilgrim Hiuen Tsang came during Harsha’s reign, gave a detailed account of Nalanda University.
 
• Nalanda was a huge monastic educational establishment.
 
• Primary teaching focus: Mahayana Buddhism, yet included other ‘secular’ subjects as well- Like, Grammar, logic, epistemology, and sciences.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Skandagupta** was the successor of** Kumaragupta and ruled from 455 CE to 467 CE**. He is known for his military campaigns against the Huns.
 
• ** Chandragupta II**, also known as **Vikramaditya, was a ruler of the Gupta dynasty** who ruled from 380 CE to 415 CE. He was known for his patronage of the arts, literature, and science.
 
• **Samudragupta** was a ruler of the Gupta dynasty who ruled from **335 CE to 375 CE.** He is known for his military conquests and his extensive empire
